rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Rierino MCP Server & Middleware enables organizations to expose any existing API, event processing, or CDC flow as MCP tools while maintaining security policies and user roles. The implementation allows for building MCP servers from scratch with database access, business rule evaluation, ML model prediction, and external API calls, or acting as middleware to 3rd party MCP servers. By creating an MCP Server Event Handler, any microservice can be enabled to handle MCP requests in a distributed, scalable architecture, with simple configuration options for defining available tools through saga mapping.
